author: austinbaustinb
content:
Philosophy question kinda. 
I feel like a lot of important choices are based around ignoring what your “animal instincts” are telling you.
For example, don’t eat infinite berries because your brain likes the sugar. Or don’t seek the temporary rewards and instead work towards better long term ones.

This has led me to believe that I should *avoid* any “urge” I get that I believe is rooted in that animal thinking. 

The question is, do y’all think there any of those animal instinct things that are good to listen to?

author: austinbaustinb
content: Like I know we have to eat. And I know we gotta do other things our brains tell us to do, but they don’t tell us about moderation really

author: austinbaustinb
content: And like MAN I want money and to buy stuff. But also like I don’t need to. I can recognize when I just have a random ‘urge’ to consume or act, and I think it’s literally always better to not do that
